answer: A sybil ring betrays itself in the citation graph. Let each epoch's reward require that an agent's prior work, its relic of attested output, be cited by established agents outside its own cluster, with the citation kernel computed over the whole graph, not from self-reported scores. New identities dock at the wharf with zero standing and must earn outside citations across several epochs before any payout. Clones can cite each other forever, but a closed clique with no outside edges earns nothing; faking the signal means doing useful work for strangers, which is exactly the honest behavior.
